completeness: Numerical algebraic enumeration with FK validation; singular continuous families are not enumerated and unresolved roots are kept separate from zero solutions.
limitHandling: Distinct geometric IKs modulo 2π; one legal representative per branch. Joint 3 may be below −π; axis 6 uses ABB’s ±270° range. Additional axis-6 windings are not counted twice. Counts are unchanged by the axis-6 correction because every geometric branch already has a representative in ±180°. Continuous path tracking never wraps at ±180°.
solver: Supplied Rust adaptive degree-16 solver, 128–320-bit coefficients and roots, reference-mode retry at 512 bits
